note: Written from usp_Insights_Dimension_Internal (sql/13_dimension_internal.sql) as deployed. Verified by SourceMapVerificationTests - every query must return exactly what the report's procedure returned. Two separate populations: statutory work (ComplianceInstance family) and the tenant's own internal work (InternalComplianceInstance family). Overdue is a live figure: a check run later can differ slightly from the report.
setup: DECLARE @UserID INT = {UserID};
DECLARE @CustomerID INT = {CustomerID};
DECLARE @WindowStart DATETIME = '{WindowStart}';
DECLARE @WindowEnd DATETIME = '{WindowEnd}';
DECLARE @AsOf DATETIME = GETDATE();
-- Step 1. Statutory obligations this user is allowed to see, with at least one due date in the period
--         (ComplianceInstance; ComplianceScheduleOn.ScheduleOn).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#stat') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #stat;
SELECT s.ComplianceInstanceID, s.BranchID INTO #stat FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopedInstances(@UserID, @CustomerID) s;
DELETE s FROM #stat s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ComplianceScheduleOn cso WHERE cso.ComplianceInstanceID = s.ComplianceInstanceID
AND cso.ScheduleOn >= @WindowStart AND cso.ScheduleOn < @WindowEnd);
-- Step 2. Statutory obligations overdue right now, and those with a performer on the obligation itself.
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#statOvd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #statOvd;
SELECT DISTINCT o.ComplianceInstanceID INTO #statOvd FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOverdueSchedules(@CustomerID, @AsOf) o
JOIN #stat s ON s.ComplianceInstanceID = o.ComplianceInstanceID;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#statOwn') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #statOwn;
SELECT ComplianceInstanceID INTO #statOwn FROM dbo.tvfInsightsOwnership(@UserID, @CustomerID) WHERE NoInstanceOwner = 0;
-- Step 3. Internal obligations at the locations this user may see (InternalComplianceInstance; location live and active),
--         with at least one due date in the period (InternalComplianceScheduledOn.ScheduledOn).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#int') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #int;
SELECT ii.ID AS InternalInstanceID, ii.CustomerBranchID AS BranchID INTO #int
FROM InternalComplianceInstance ii JOIN CustomerBranch cb ON cb.ID = ii.CustomerBranchID
WHERE ii.IsDeleted = 0 AND cb.IsDeleted = 0 AND cb.Status = 1 AND cb.CustomerID = @CustomerID
AND ii.CustomerBranchID IN (SELECT BranchID FROM dbo.tvfInsightsScopePairs(@UserID, @CustomerID));
DELETE i FROM #int i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM InternalComplianceScheduledOn iso WHERE iso.InternalComplianceInstanceID = i.InternalInstanceID
AND iso.ScheduledOn >= @WindowStart AND iso.ScheduledOn < @WindowEnd);
-- Step 4. Internal obligations overdue right now (a past due date whose latest status counts as overdue in the
--         status dictionary vInsightsStatusCurrent), and those with a performer (InternalComplianceAssignment, RoleID 3).
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#intOvd') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #intOvd;
SELECT DISTINCT i.InternalInstanceID INTO #intOvd FROM #int i
JOIN InternalComplianceScheduledOn iso ON iso.InternalComplianceInstanceID = i.InternalInstanceID
JOIN InternalComplianceTransaction it ON it.InternalComplianceScheduledOnID = iso.ID
JOIN dbo.vInsightsStatusCurrent d ON d.StatusId = it.StatusId
WHERE iso.IsActive = 1 AND iso.IsUpcomingNotDeleted = 1 AND iso.ScheduledOn <= @AsOf AND d.OverdueEligible = 1;
IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#intOwn') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #intOwn;
SELECT DISTINCT ia.InternalComplianceInstanceID AS InternalInstanceID INTO #intOwn
FROM InternalComplianceAssignment ia JOIN #int i ON i.InternalInstanceID = ia.InternalComplianceInstanceID
WHERE ia.RoleID = 3 AND ia.UserID > 0;

checks.name: Statutory share with no performer on the obligation itself (%)
checks.tables: Statutory obligations not in #statOwn / all statutory x 100. Blank when there is no statutory work.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.ComplianceInstanceID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #stat s LEFT JOIN #statOwn w ON w.ComplianceInstanceID = s.ComplianceInstanceID;

checks.name: Internal share with no performer (%)
checks.tables: Internal obligations not in #intOwn / all internal x 100. Blank when there is no internal work.
query: SELECT CAST(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.InternalInstanceID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS Value
FROM #int i LEFT JOIN #intOwn w ON w.InternalInstanceID = i.InternalInstanceID;
